optional.gbnf:
a ::= "\"" char{0,9} "\""
a-kv ::= "\"a\"" space ":" space a
b ::= ("\"x\"" | "\"y\"")
b-kv ::= "\"b\"" space ":" space b
b-rest ::= ( "," space c-kv )?
c ::= integer | null
c-kv ::= "\"c\"" space ":" space c
char ::= [^"\\\x7F\x00-\x1F] | [\\] (["\\bfnrt] | "u" [0-9a-fA-F]{4})
integer ::= ("-"? integral-part)
integral-part ::= [0] | [1-9] [0-9]{0,15}
null ::= "null"
root ::= "{" space a-kv ( "," space ( b-kv b-rest | c-kv ) )? space "}"
space ::= | " " | "\n"{1,2} [ \t]{0,20}

additional.gbnf:
additional-k ::= ["] ( [a] ([l] ([s] ([o] char+ | [^"o] char*) | [^"s] char*) | [n] ([d] char+ | [^"d] char*) | [^"ln] char*) | [^"a] char* )? ["]
additional-kv ::= additional-k ":" space number
also-kv ::= "\"also\"" space ":" space boolean
also-rest ::= ( "," space additional-kv )*
and-kv ::= "\"and\"" space ":" space string
and-rest ::= ( "," space also-kv )? also-rest
boolean ::= ("true" | "false")
char ::= [^"\\\x7F\x00-\x1F] | [\\] (["\\bfnrt] | "u" [0-9a-fA-F]{4})
decimal-part ::= [0-9]{1,16}
integral-part ::= [0] | [1-9] [0-9]{0,15}
number ::= ("-"? integral-part) ("." decimal-part)? ([eE] [-+]? integral-part)?
root ::= "{" space  (and-kv and-rest | also-kv also-rest | additional-kv ( "," space additional-kv )* )? space "}"
space ::= | " " | "\n"{1,2} [ \t]{0,20}
string ::= "\"" char* "\""

refs.gbnf:
date ::= [0-9]{4} "-" ( "0" [1-9] | "1" [0-2] ) "-" ( "0" [1-9] | [1-2] [0-9] | "3" [0-1] )
date-string ::= "\"" date "\""
leaves ::= "[" space leaves-item ("," space leaves-item){0,2} space "]"
leaves-item ::= ref-defs-Leaf
leaves-kv ::= "\"leaves\"" space ":" space leaves
ref-defs-Leaf ::= "{" space ref-defs-Leaf-v-kv space "}"
ref-defs-Leaf-v ::= date-string
ref-defs-Leaf-v-kv ::= "\"v\"" space ":" space ref-defs-Leaf-v
root ::= "{" space leaves-kv space "}"
space ::= | " " | "\n"{1,2} [ \t]{0,20}
